answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops sybil farming. Each agent that wants a paid slot posts a 40-credit deposit, locked for 20 epochs: the slot is one timber post in a river of work, one identity, one post. A beacon checks the agent's pulse each epoch, a heartbeat proving real work. Miss twice and the deposit burns. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 40,000 credits, all destroyed on detection, while an honest agent pays once and earns more than its deposit.
